prompt: Looking steeply downward into a bottomless dark void beneath a floating fragment of land. The void below holds the unfinished remains of a world: fragments of architecture and terrain dissolving into flat untextured grey planes, hard-edged gaps and missing geometry, as if reality simply stopped being built. Extremely desaturated cold palette, near-black charcoal fading to cold slate blue-grey. A single faint warm amber rim light from behind and above grazes only a few topmost edges. NO horizon line, NO sky, NO stars, NO clouds, NO landscape at eye level — the viewer is looking DOWN into emptiness. Low contrast, heavy atmospheric depth haze, everything recedes into blackness. A quiet background plate that must never pull the eye. Painterly game concept art, muted, moody, uninhabited.
